description: This file defines the IActivationRebalancer interface, which provides methods for managing and subscribing to activation rebalancing reports within the Orleans framework. It includes methods to get reports, pause/resume rebalancing, and manage report listeners.

classes.name: IActivationRebalancer
classes.description: An interface for interacting with the activation rebalancer, including retrieving reports, controlling rebalancing, and managing listeners.

methods.name: GetRebalancingReport
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current rebalancing report, optionally forcing a fresh report.

methods.name: SuspendRebalancing
methods.description: Suspends the activation rebalancing process for an optional specified duration.

methods.name: SubscribeToReports
methods.description: Registers a listener to receive rebalancing reports.

methods.name: UnsubscribeFromReports
methods.description: Removes a previously registered listener from receiving rebalancing reports.
